stepTexts.0: Lie down on your back. Head tipped back, over the edge. Your throat is lined up — you're going to take it all.
stepTexts.8: On your back, throat open, you let me in. Slowly.
stepTexts.24: Stay on your back. Don't lift your head. Further.
stepTexts.34: Hold. Your throat is made for this in this position.
stepTexts.54: Again. On your back, throat wide open, you take me to the root.
stepTexts.70: Good. On your back, you're nothing but a throat. You know this position now.
